QuestInfo.name: Mai's Request
QuestInfo.0: #b#p9201208##k stands at #b#m690000007##k. They say she is the strongest in Maple Island.... Why is she here? What's her life story like? Let's see #p9201208#.
QuestInfo.1: #p9201208# is a new adventurer and worker on Victoria Island. But the elder, #p9201203# in #m690000018# hired her in case of any dangerous situations on Maple Island. #p9201208# says it's a hard time now because of all the work....Let's tell #b#p9201203##k what #p9201208# said.
QuestInfo.2: #p9201203# agreed with what #p9201208# said. He said it's better to hire more workers. Then he asked me to tell #b#p1002101##k in #b#m690000029##k... #m690000029# is in Victoria Island...I have to go to  #b#p9201200##k in #b#m690000009##k.

0.0: Maple Island is a place for new Explorers. The monsters aren't that strong, but they're a match for the likes of you. Don't let your guard down!\r\n#b#L0# I'm not a newbie! Well... You do seem really strong. Why are you here?#l
0.1: That's because I'm a trainer. Mr.#p9201203# hired me for people in Maple Island. That's why I quit adventuring in Victoria Island and started protecting people in this town instead. Besides that, beginners always need a bit of guidance. But I've got far too much work these days...If you have a chance to go to #m1010000#, can you give a message to Mr. #p9201203#?

yes.0: Ah, thank you. There are a lot of travelers in Maple Island and even more monsters. It's hard for me to protect people by myself. So please tell the senior #b#p9201203##k of #b#m690000018##k to hire one more person. Thank you.

no.0: Hmm... I'm sure you'll help me when your ready!

1.0:
Hmm... Who are you? Did #p9201208# send you to me? Why did #p9201208# send you to me? 
#b#L0# #p9201208# asked you to raise salary. #l
#L1#Because there are many beginners in Maple Island, it's hard for #p9201208# to work by her. #l
#L2# #p9201208# said she wanted to compete with you. #l
1.1: Hmm... Did #p9201208# really say that to you? She has never been wrong before. Then I guess we do need to have another person around to protect the new maplers!

yes.0: Thank you for helping out. Make sure you head to #b#m690000009##k and take the ship to Victoria Island. #b#p9201200##k is the one you'll want to talk to to start the trip.

0.0: Mai asked for a raise? I don't believe it. Are you lying?
0.2: Compete...? Did Mai say that? I know there's no strong men in Maple Island, but it's nonsense to ask this old man like me to compete.

npc.0: Haven't you met #b#p9201203##k yet? I'll take a walk in front of the store of #b#m690000018##k. Go ahead.
